Battleaxe

Internal ID: Battleaxe | Type: Axe | Source: Forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Ancient bark x15, Iron x45 | Attack speed: 0.84 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.5 range, 30 angle, 1.0 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -15%

Introduction. The battleaxe is the first two-handed axe. Its primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit, 1.5x staggering and no multitarget penalty. Its faster secondary attack deals 0.5x damage and 4x staggering.

Notes. • The first hit is very slow. The last two hits take about the same time, while in total dealing triple damage.
